title: Simulator verification and smoke matrix
purpose: Verify determinism, zero-drift negative control, candidate exclusion, norms, bounds, schema; measure runtime and pilot variance
planned_analysis: Pass/fail table; pilot SD of SIM-RAND drift difference for seed-count decision

title: Policy effect on simulated taste and exposure
purpose: Test whether SIM changes adaptive simulated taste differently from uniform-random exposure; compare 5 policies x fixed/adaptive on all metrics
primary_outcome: Mean angular preference drift (rad); SIM minus RAND paired by seed
planned_analysis: Paired bootstrap 95% CI over 10 seeds; d_z; SESOI 0.05 rad; Holm for secondary drift contrasts

title: Drift-assumption sensitivity and adaptation ablation
purpose: Check whether the EXP-002 contrast survives other update rules, drift rates and oracle vs estimated profile
planned_analysis: Per-cell paired bootstrap 95% CI; pre-specified retain/withdraw rule
